import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    se=np.sqrt(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*np.log(T)+p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*T)+p[6]*se
            +p[7]*eps**2*np.exp(-p[8]*T)+p[9]*eps**2*np.log(T))
